title: The Bank Vault Override Time
description:
🔐 Encrypted USB Drive:
Vault timer set for 12 hours at 8:00 PM.
Override key used 2 hours earlier than scheduled opening time.
question: At what time was the vault opened?
hints: Opened 2 hours earlier: 8:00 AM minus 2 hours = 6:00 AM.
solution: Scheduled opening 8:00 AM minus 2 hours override = 6:00 AM.
